stem: What is the most likely reason that the author uses direct address at the beginning of paragraph 1?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 1.

If you had to choose just one, would you vote to fund new air conditioners in the cafeteria or a school carnival?

options.label: A
options.text: To help the reader relate to the decision-making process that budgeting requires

options.label: B
options.text: To encourage the reader to research facts about how money is budgeted for schools

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest to the reader that budgets take time and cooperation to successfully create

options.label: D
options.text: To emphasize to the reader that voting on how to spend school budget money works

visual_elements: If you had to choose just one, would you vote to fund new air conditioners in the cafeteria or a school carnival?
